**Methodological description (English):** Use spatial patterns, scale, source limitations and visible characteristics in aerial or satellite observations to infer geographic features and land-cover change. Comparing two dated images is one application of this competence.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Geografiialyq nysandar men özgerısterdı zertteu üşın äueden nemese jerserıkten tüsırılgen suretterdı tüsındır.

##### Bağdarlanu üşın jerserıktık oryn derekterın qoldanu

[useSatellitePositioningInformationForGeographicOrientation.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/geospatialTechnologies/useSatellitePositioningInformationForGeographicOrientation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret a position supplied by a GNSS device in relation to a coordinate reference and the surrounding geography; recognize that positioning has uncertainty and does not directly describe what is at the location.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jerserık arqyly anyqtalğan oryndy paidalan, bıraq onyñ dälsızdıgı boluy mümkın ekenın esker.

#### Globustar, kartalar jäne proektsiialar

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/globesMapsAndProjection/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A spherical Earth cannot be shown on a flat sheet without some distortion, and different representations support different questions. Choosing one is a reasoning decision rather than a display preference.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kartalar men globustar Jerdıñ qisyq betın qalai ärtürlı körsetetının zertte.

##### Globus pen jazyq kartany Jer modelderı retınde ajyratu

[distinguishAGlobeFromAFlatMapAsEarthModels.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/globesMapsAndProjection/distinguishAGlobeFromAFlatMapAsEarthModels.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain why a globe represents the overall shape of Earth more directly while a flat map is easier to use for selected areas or purposes.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Globus jazyq kartağa qarağanda nenı tıkelei körsetetının tüsındır.

##### Proektsiiadağy audan men pışın būrmalanuyn tanu

[recognizeProjectionDistortionInAreaOrShape.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/globesMapsAndProjection/recognizeProjectionDistortionInAreaOrShape.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify that apparent sizes and shapes can change when the curved surface is flattened, especially when comparing distant latitudes.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jer betın jazyqtyqqa tüsıru ölşemder men pışınderdı qalai özgertetının tany.

##### Maqsatqa sai geografiialyq beineleudı tañdau

[selectAGeographicRepresentationForAPurpose.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/globesMapsAndProjection/selectAGeographicRepresentationForAPurpose.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Choose a globe, world or regional map, or detailed street plan according to the required spatial extent, scale and projection properties. This concerns the _representation and coverage_; choosing the subject matter of a political, geological or population map is a separate Skill.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Geografiialyq maqsatqa sai globus, keñ aumaq kartasy ne tolyq jospar tañda.

#### Karta jasau jäne kartografiialyq şarttylyqtar

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapDesignAndConventions/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Creating and interpreting maps requires deliberate choices of symbols, legends, orientation, scale and labels. Conventions allow readers to infer geographic meaning from an authored representation without treating a map as a literal replica of the ground.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Belgıler, şartty belgıler tüsındırmesı, masştab pen bağyt kartany tüsınuge qalai kömektesetının bıl.

##### Kartalar jasau

[createMaps.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapDesignAndConventions/createMaps.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Select an appropriate spatial extent and represent places or geographically referenced information with consistent symbols, orientation, labels and scale as needed for a communication purpose. Sketching a classroom plan and constructing a thematic map are applications, not automatically distinct Skills.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tiıstı belgıler, jazular, bağdar men masştab arqyly tüsınıktı karta jasa.

##### Kartanyñ bağytyn soltüstık körsetkışımen anyqtau

[determineMapOrientationFromItsNorthIndicator.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapDesignAndConventions/determineMapOrientationFromItsNorthIndicator.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use the map's stated orientation rather than assuming the top of every depiction is geographic north.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Soltüstık ärdaiym joğaryda dep oilamai, kartany soltüstık belgısıne qarap bağytta.

##### Karta masştabyn qaşyqtyqtar qatynasy retınde tüsındıru

[interpretAMapScaleAsADistanceRelationship.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapDesignAndConventions/interpretAMapScaleAsADistanceRelationship.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize that a short mark on paper or screen represents a larger distance on the ground and that the ratio changes with scale.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kartadağy araqaşyqtyqtyñ jerdegı araqaşyqtyqpen bailanysyn tüsındır.

##### Karta şartty belgılerın tüsındırme arqyly oqu

[interpretConventionalMapSymbolsThroughALegend.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapDesignAndConventions/interpretConventionalMapSymbolsThroughALegend.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect a symbol or color to its documented meaning instead of assuming that its appearance is self-explanatory.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Belgıler men tüsterdıñ mağynasyn karta tüsındırmesınen tap.

#### Karta türlerı men taqyryptyq qabattar

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapTypesAndThematicLayers/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Maps may emphasize general reference features, political territories, physical relief, topography or specific themes such as geology, population, climate, weather, transport and resources. Categories overlap: for example, a geological or population map is thematic, and many maps combine layers. Choosing the relevant content is distinct from choosing a globe or map scale.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärtürlı kartalar şekaralardy, jer bederın, aua raiyn, adamdardy qalai körsetetının bıl.

##### Mazmūny boiynşa kartanyñ keñ tarağan türlerın anyqtau

[identifyCommonMapTypesByTheirInformationContent.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapTypesAndThematicLayers/identifyCommonMapTypesByTheirInformationContent.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize whether a map presents political boundaries, physical relief, topographic detail, geological units, climate, population, resources or transport, using its title, legend and depicted variables. Explain that reference and thematic are broad roles, not mutually exclusive lists of named maps.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Karta qandai geografiialyq aqparat beretının anyqta.

##### Taqyryptyq tüsındırme men mänder sanattaryn tüsınu

[interpretAThematicLegendAndItsValueClasses.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapTypesAndThematicLayers/interpretAThematicLegendAndItsValueClasses.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate mapped color ranges, symbol sizes, or categories to the underlying variable while respecting units and class boundaries.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Taqyryptyq tüsındırme arqyly kartadağy sanat, aralyq jäne mänderdı oqy.

##### Geografiialyq sūraqqa karta türın tañdau

[selectAMapTypeForAGeographicQuestion.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/mapsAndGeospatialRepresentations/mapTypesAndThematicLayers/selectAMapTypeForAGeographicQuestion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Match a question to the type of information a map must show: for example, use a geological map to investigate rock distribution or a population-density map to compare settlement concentration. Do not substitute a visually attractive map lacking the required variable.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Naqty geografiialyq sūraqqa säikes karta türın tañda.

### Tabiği aimaqtar jäne biogeografiia

Groups: 3 · Skills: 10

[index.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Natural conditions create geographic variation in ecosystems, biodiversity and habitat patterns on land and in water. This field describes where ecological regions occur, how their distributions vary and how landscape changes affect them; organism physiology and detailed food-web mechanisms belong primarily to Biology.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Klimat, jer bederı men sudyñ tırı ağzalardyñ geografiialyq taraluyna qalai äser etetının zertte.

#### Biomdar men tırşılık ortalary

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/biomesAndHabitats/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Broad vegetation and habitat patterns reflect environmental conditions while local ecosystems can be more varied than a single biome label suggests.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Älemnıñ är bölıgınde tırşılık ortasynyñ ärtürlı negızgı türlerı nege kezdesetının bıl.

##### Ärtürlı geografiialyq oryndardağy tırşılık ortasynyñ jağdailaryn salystyru

[compareHabitatConditionsBetweenGeographicLocations.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/biomesAndHabitats/compareHabitatConditionsBetweenGeographicLocations.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use temperature, moisture, altitude, and land cover to explain contrasts in living conditions for organisms.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärtürlı jerde ärqily tırşılık ortasy qalyptasatyn jağdailardy salystyr.

##### Negızgı qūrlyq biomdarynyñ taralu zañdylyqtaryn anyqtau

[identifyMajorTerrestrialBiomePatterns.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/biomesAndHabitats/identifyMajorTerrestrialBiomePatterns.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Associate broad forest, grassland, desert, and tundra patterns with environmental conditions rather than treating them as isolated species lists.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ormandardyñ, şalğyndardyñ, şölder men tundranyñ älemdık taralu zañdylyqtaryn tany.

##### Biomdar arasyndağy ötpelı aimaqtardy tanu

[recognizeTransitionZonesBetweenBiomes.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/biomesAndHabitats/recognizeTransitionZonesBetweenBiomes.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify that vegetation and environmental conditions may change gradually across boundaries rather than at a perfectly sharp line.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Biomdardyñ şekaralary kenet emes, bırtındep nelıkten özgeruı mümkın ekenın tüsın.

#### Ekojüieler

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/ecosystems/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Ecosystems develop under different physical conditions on land and in water, and can vary markedly in spatial extent and connectivity. Geography focuses on the distributions of terrestrial, marine and freshwater environments, their boundaries, fragmentation and regional relationships, rather than organism physiology.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärtürlı ekojüielerdıñ qaida ornalasatynyn jäne landşaft boiymen qalai bailanysatynyn zertte.

##### Teñız jäne tūşşy su ekojüielerın ajyratu

[distinguishMarineAndFreshwaterEcosystems.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/ecosystems/distinguishMarineAndFreshwaterEcosystems.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Differentiate aquatic ecosystems shaped by saline ocean or sea water from those associated with predominantly fresh rivers, lakes and wetlands. Use salinity, water movement and geographic connections to explain broad habitat differences; recognize estuaries and other brackish transitional environments instead of forcing every location into one of two categories.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Teñız, tūşşy su jäne ötpelı tūzdylau su ortalaryn ajyrat.

##### Tırşılık ortasynyñ bölşektenuın geografiialyq üderıs retınde tüsındıru

[explainHabitatFragmentationAsAGeographicProcess.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/ecosystems/explainHabitatFragmentationAsAGeographicProcess.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate roads, land-cover change or other barriers to the separation of formerly connected habitat areas, recognizing that the ecological consequences depend on species and landscape context.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Joldar nemese jer paidalanu özgerısterı būryn bailanysqan tırşılık ortalaryn qalai böle alatynyn tüsındır.

##### Tabiği tırşılık ortalarynyñ bailanysyn tüsındıru

[interpretConnectivityBetweenNaturalHabitats.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/ecosystems/interpretConnectivityBetweenNaturalHabitats.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess whether geographic corridors or barriers link habitat patches and enable movement across a landscape, without claiming that proximity automatically guarantees ecological connection.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tırşılık ortasynyñ bölıkterı arasyndağy tabiği dälızder men kedergılerdı anyqta.

##### Bioaluantürlılıktıñ geografiialyq taraluyn taldau

[interpretGeographicPatternsOfBiodiversity.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/ecosystems/interpretGeographicPatternsOfBiodiversity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify broad differences in variety of living organisms across mapped regions and relate them cautiously to climate, habitat complexity, disturbance and observation coverage.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Baqylaulardağy aiyrmaşylyqty eskerıp, kartalar boiynşa öñırlerdıñ bioaluantürlılıgın salystyr.

#### Ekologiialyq gradientter

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/environmentalGradients/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Natural conditions often vary systematically with elevation, latitude, and proximity to water. Such gradients help explain patterns without implying that every place at the same latitude is identical.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Endıkke, biıktıkke jäne suğa jaqyndyqqa qarai tabiğat qalai özgeretının zertte.

##### Endıkke qarai qorşağan ortanyñ jalpy aiyrmaşylyğyn tüsındıru

[explainBroadEnvironmentalVariationWithLatitude.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/environmentalGradients/explainBroadEnvironmentalVariationWithLatitude.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect differences in solar input and circulation to large-scale environmental belts while allowing local exceptions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Endık pen kün säulesı jäne tabiği jağdailardağy ülken aiyrmaşylyqtardy bailanystyr.

##### Salystyrmaly geografiialyq derekter arqyly qorşağan orta özgerısterın anyqtau

[identifyEnvironmentalShiftsFromComparativeGeographicEvidence.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/environmentalGradients/identifyEnvironmentalShiftsFromComparativeGeographicEvidence.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use two dated distributions or observations to describe a change in habitat range, without automatically assigning a single cause.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärtürlı uaqyttağy kartalar men baqylaulardy salystyryp, tırşılık ortasynyñ özgerısın baiqa.

##### Biıktıkke qarai tabiği jağdailardyñ özgerısın tanu

[recognizeAltitudinalChangesInNaturalConditions.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/naturalRegionsAndBiogeography/environmentalGradients/recognizeAltitudinalChangesInNaturalConditions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe how cooler temperatures and vegetation zones can occur higher on mountains without assuming identical patterns everywhere.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tau betkeiımen joğarylağan saiyn tırşılık ortasy men temperatura qalai özgeretının tany.

### Keñıstıkte bağdarlanu

Groups: 4 · Skills: 16

[index.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Locating and orienting oneself requires a stable or relative reference, directions, remembered spatial relationships and awareness of changing spatial and temporal frames. These competencies concern where places are, how we navigate between them, and how their civil and solar times relate—not how maps are drawn.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Oryndar, bağyttar, joldar men uaqyt aiyrmaşylyğy bağdar tabuğa qalai kömektesetının bıl.

#### Ornalasu jäne bağdar nüktelerı

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/locationAndReference/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Locations can be described relative to a chosen reference, identified using stable geographic or civic references, and situated within areas of different spatial extent. The identity of the reference must be explicit rather than assumed from the observer.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Aiqyn bağdar nüktelerın paidalanyp, oryndardy sipattaudy üiren.

##### Oryndy bağdar nüktesıne qatysty sipattau

[describeALocationRelativeToAReferencePoint.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/locationAndReference/describeALocationRelativeToAReferencePoint.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Express where a place lies by referring to another identifiable object or location, such as 'east of the station' or 'next to the bridge'. The statement changes meaning when its reference point changes.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır närsenıñ basqa tanys orynğa qatysty qaida ornalasqanyn sipatta.

##### Oryndy tūraqty derek arqyly anyqtau

[identifyALocationUsingAnAbsoluteReference.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/locationAndReference/identifyALocationUsingAnAbsoluteReference.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use a stable agreed identifier, such as a coordinate pair in a named system or an address within a specified jurisdiction, to locate a place independently of a movable observer. Interpreting latitude and longitude is a separate cartographic competency.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mekenjai ne koordinattar siiaqty tūraqty derekke süienıp, oryndy tap.

##### Oryndy jergılıktı, aimaqtyq jäne jahandyq auqymda anyqtau

[identifyLocationAtLocalRegionalAndGlobalScales.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/locationAndReference/identifyLocationAtLocalRegionalAndGlobalScales.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate the same place to nested areas such as a neighborhood, country, and world region without confusing a change of scale with physical movement.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bır oryndy audan, aimaq jäne älem auqymynda anyqta.

#### Bağdarlau jäne oişa kartalar

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/navigationAndMentalMaps/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Moving between places relies on orientation, directional instructions, and sequences of turns. The focus is spatial navigation, not the mathematical calculation of distance.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bağyttar, bağdar nüktelerı jäne este saqtalğan keñıstıktık bailanystar arqyly jol tabudy üiren.

##### Rettı aralyq nükteler arqyly bağyt qūru

[constructARouteThroughOrderedWaypoints.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/navigationAndMentalMaps/constructARouteThroughOrderedWaypoints.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Choose an intelligible sequence of landmarks and turns between two positions, checking that the instructions preserve connectivity.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bağdarlar men būrylystardy dūrys rettep, tūtas bağyt josparla.

##### Negızgı bağyttarmen jolda bağdarlanu

[useCardinalDirectionsToOrientARoute.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/navigationAndMentalMaps/useCardinalDirectionsToOrientARoute.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Associate north, east, south, and west with actual movement or a stated orientation, even when the observer faces a different way.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Marşrutpen jürgende soltüstık, oñtüstık, şyğys jäne batys bağyttaryn paidalan.

##### Aralyq bağyttar arqyly bağdarlardy ajyratu

[useIntermediateDirectionsToDistinguishBearings.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/navigationAndMentalMaps/useIntermediateDirectionsToDistinguishBearings.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Locate positions such as northeast between adjacent cardinal directions rather than treating the compass as only four separate choices.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kompaspen soltüstık-şyğys pen oñtüstık-batysty tany.

##### Keñıstıkte bağdarlanuğa oişa kartalardy qoldanu

[useMentalMapsForSpatialOrientation.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/navigationAndMentalMaps/useMentalMapsForSpatialOrientation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Represent remembered places and spatial relationships internally, and use that representation to reason about position or a route without consulting a physical map. Drawing a familiar route, revising it after a new observation and imagining landmarks are different exercises for the same transferable spatial ability.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Este qalğan oryndar arqyly qaida ekenıñdı jäne basqa jerge qalai jetetınıñdı anyqta.

#### Keñıstıktık bailanystar

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/spatialRelationships/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Places and features form patterns of nearness, containment, connection, concentration, and separation. These relationships matter even when the exact names of the locations change.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Oryndardyñ qalai bailanysatynyn, bölınetının nemese belgılı zañdylyqpen ornalasatynyn tany.

##### Şoğyrlanğan jäne şaşyrañqy ornalasudy sipattau

[describeClusteredAndDispersedArrangements.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/spatialRelationships/describeClusteredAndDispersedArrangements.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare objects gathered in a small area with objects spread across a larger one while considering the observation scale.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Nysandar toptasyp tūr ma, älde şaşyrañqy ma, sipatta.

##### Irgelestık pen jaqyndyqty ajyratu

[distinguishAdjacencyFromProximity.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/spatialRelationships/distinguishAdjacencyFromProximity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Two territories may share a boundary without being close to the same external landmark; nearby places need not touch.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Şektesetın oryndardy tek jaqyn ornalasqan oryndardan ajyrat.

##### Oryndar arasyndağy kedergıler men dälızderdı anyqtau

[identifyBarriersAndCorridorsBetweenPlaces.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/spatialRelationships/identifyBarriersAndCorridorsBetweenPlaces.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain how a mountain range, river crossing, valley, or road can restrict or enable movement between otherwise nearby locations.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Taular, añğarlar, joldar men ötkelder oryndar arasyndağy qatynasqa qalai äser etetının tüsındır.

#### Uaqyt beldeulerı

Skills: 6

[index.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Earth's rotation gives different longitudes different solar timing, while societies coordinate clocks through geographically assigned civil time rules. The same place can be described by its solar time, legal time-zone assignment, UTC offset and calendar date; these are related but not interchangeable.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jerdıñ ainaluy men jergılıktı erejeler sağat körsetetın uaqytty qalai anyqtaitynyn zertte.

##### Berılgen UTC yğysuymen azamattyq uaqytty anyqtau

[determineCivilTimeUsingASpecifiedUTCOffset.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/determineCivilTimeUsingASpecifiedUTCOffset.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply a stated positive or negative offset to a known UTC time for a particular date, including when the resulting local date moves to the previous or next day. Do not infer an offset from longitude alone.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Berılgen UTC uaqyty men yğysuynan jergılıktı uaqytty tap, künnıñ auysuyn esker.

##### Resmi uaqyttyñ mausymdyq özgerısın tüsındıru

[explainSeasonalChangesToCivilClockTime.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/explainSeasonalChangesToCivilClockTime.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify that some jurisdictions change their legal UTC offsets seasonally while others do not, and that the applicable rule depends on place and date rather than a universal daylight-saving schedule.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Nelıkten keibır jerlerde sağatty mausym saiyn özgertetının, basqalarda özgertpeitının tüsın.

##### Jergılıktı azamattyq uaqyt ūğymyn tüsındıru

[explainTheConceptOfLocalCivilTime.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/explainTheConceptOfLocalCivilTime.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Explain that the legally observed clock time in a place depends on the jurisdiction and applicable time zone, and can differ from the Sun's position. Civil local time is not the same concept as local solar time, and different places can share one civil clock time.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Belgılı jerdıñ zañdy sağat uaqytyn Künge negızdelgen uaqyttan ajyrat.

##### Jergılıktı kün uaqytynyñ boilyqqa täueldılıgın tüsındıru

[explainWhyLocalSolarTimeVariesWithLongitude.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/explainWhyLocalSolarTimeVariesWithLongitude.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect Earth's rotation with the apparent passage of the Sun across the sky: places at different longitudes reach solar noon at different moments. This geographic tendency is not a rule that political zone boundaries follow exact meridians.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärtürlı boilyqtarda kün taltüsı nege är uaqytta bolatynyn tüsındır.

##### Halyqaralyq kün auystyru syzyğynan ötkendegı kün özgerısın tüsındıru

[interpretCalendarDateChangesAcrossTheInternationalDateLine.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/interpretCalendarDateChangesAcrossTheInternationalDateLine.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Determine why adjacent locations on opposite sides of the approximate Pacific date boundary can have different calendar dates, noting that its actual course follows regional civil-time choices rather than a perfectly straight meridian.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Halyqaralyq kün auystyru syzyğynan ötu küntızbedegı kündı nege özgertuı mümkın ekenın tüsındır.

##### Geografiialyq kartadağy uaqyt beldeulerın tüsındıru

[interpretTimeZonesOnAGeographicMap.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/spatialOrientation/timeZones/interpretTimeZonesOnAGeographicMap.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Locate places assigned to different civil time zones using a legend or UTC offsets; recognize that boundaries may follow political borders and that some regions use half-hour or quarter-hour offsets.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kartadan uaqyt beldeulerınıñ şekarasy men UTC yğysularyn oqy.

### Su jüielerı

Groups: 4 · Skills: 13

[index.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Water connects landscapes through drainage networks, oceans, atmosphere, and underground storage. Geographic questions center on where water moves and accumulates, how its distribution varies, and how water features shape places.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jerdegı su qaida jinalyp, qalai qozğalyp, jer bederın qalai qalyptastyratynyn zertte.

#### Mūzdağan jäne jerasty sulary

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Snow, ice and groundwater store freshwater for different durations and interact with landscapes and human supplies. Their accumulation and discharge vary with climate, geology and geography rather than being visible only in rivers.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qar, mūz jäne jerasty sulary tūşşy sudy qalai saqtaitynyn bıl.

##### Mūzdyqtardyñ tüzıluı men qozğalysyn tüsındıru

[explainHowGlaciersFormAndMove.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater/explainHowGlaciersFormAndMove.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate sustained snow accumulation and compaction to slowly flowing land ice, distinguishing glaciers from seasonal snow cover and floating sea ice.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jinalğan qardyñ baiau jyljityn mūzdyqqa qalai ainalatynyn tüsındır.

##### Mūzdyqtardyñ jer bederın özgertuın tüsındıru

[explainHowGlaciersReshapeTerrain.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater/explainHowGlaciersReshapeTerrain.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize broad erosional and depositional outcomes of moving land ice, such as glacial valleys, moraines and transported sediment, without treating all U-shaped valleys as proof of one event.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mūzdyqtar qaşap nemese qaldyryp ketken jer bederı pışınderın tany.

##### Jerasty su ötkızgış qabaty ūğymyn tüsındıru

[explainTheConceptOfAGroundwaterAquifer.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater/explainTheConceptOfAGroundwaterAquifer.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify a permeable geological layer or formation that can store and transmit useful groundwater, distinguishing an aquifer from an open underground lake.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Su ötkızgış jynystar jerasty suyn qalai saqtap, ötkızetının tüsın.

##### Tūşşy su qorynyñ geografiialyq aiyrmalaryn tüsındıru

[interpretGeographicVariationsInFreshwaterStorage.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/frozenAndSubsurfaceWater/interpretGeographicVariationsInFreshwaterStorage.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare places in which ice, aquifers, lakes or rivers hold accessible freshwater, recognizing differences in replenishment, seasonal availability and extraction limits.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Öñırlerdegı mūz, su ötkızgış qabat, köl men özen suyn qor retınde salystyr.

#### Gidrologiialyq bailanystar

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/hydrologicConnections/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Water changes location and state among the atmosphere, surface, living systems, and subsurface. This is a connected circulation model rather than a single linear loop.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sudyñ aua, qūrlyq, ağzalar jäne jerasty qorlary arasynda qalai ainalatynyn bıl.

##### Öñırler arasyndağy su qoljetımdılıgın salystyru

[compareGeographicWaterAvailabilityAcrossRegions.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/hydrologicConnections/compareGeographicWaterAvailabilityAcrossRegions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate precipitation, storage, seasonal variation, and demand to differences in accessible fresh water, rather than equating wet weather with secure supply.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärtürlı öñırlerdegı qoljetımdı tūşşy sudy salystyr.

##### Sıñu men jerasty suynyñ tolyğuyn tüsındıru

[explainInfiltrationAndGroundwaterRecharge.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/hydrologicConnections/explainInfiltrationAndGroundwaterRecharge.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect water entering permeable soils and rock to subsurface flow and replenishment of groundwater storage, distinguishing a downward pathway from direct surface runoff.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Sudyñ topyraq pen jynystarğa ötıp, jerasty suyn tolyqtyruyn tüsındır.

##### Jer betı ağynyn tüsındıru

[explainSurfaceRunoffAsAWaterPathway.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/hydrologicConnections/explainSurfaceRunoffAsAWaterPathway.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe water moving across land toward lower terrain and drainage networks when rainfall or melt exceeds infiltration and storage, distinguishing the process from water already stored underground.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Artyq jañbyr men erıgen qar suynyñ jer betımen ağuyn sipatta.

##### Su ainalymyn tüsındıru

[explainTheHydrologicCycle.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/hydrologicConnections/explainTheHydrologicCycle.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Describe the movement and storage of water among atmosphere, surface, living systems, ice and subsurface through evaporation, condensation, precipitation and flow. The cycles are multiple interconnected paths, not one mandatory linear sequence.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bulanu, jauyn-şaşyn, jinalu men ağudyñ bailanysyn tüsındır.

#### Teñız jäne jağalau üderısterı

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/marineAndCoastalProcesses/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Coastal and marine environments differ in exposure, enclosure, water movement, and relation to land. The emphasis is on geographic patterns and coastal form rather than detailed fluid dynamics.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tolqyndar, tolysu-qaitu jäne ağystar jağalau men mūhitqa qalai äser etetının zertte.

##### Jağalau şaiyluy men şögındı jinalu pışınderın anyqtau

[identifyCoastalErosionAndDepositionFeatures.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/marineAndCoastalProcesses/identifyCoastalErosionAndDepositionFeatures.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate cliffs, beaches, spits, or deltas to material removal and accumulation in their coastal setting.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Şaiylu men şögındıler jinaluynan tuğan jağalau pışınderın tany.

##### Mūhit ağystarynyñ geografiialyq ülgılerın tüsındıru

[interpretGeographicPatternsOfOceanCurrents.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/marineAndCoastalProcesses/interpretGeographicPatternsOfOceanCurrents.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize major surface-current directions and geographic effects on coastal climate, transport and marine conditions, without confusing circulation with periodic tidal change.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mūhit ağystarynyñ taraluy men jağalauğa yqpalyn tüsındır.

##### Mūhittağy tolysu-qaitudyñ geografiialyq ülgılerın tüsındıru

[interpretGeographicPatternsOfOceanTides.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/marineAndCoastalProcesses/interpretGeographicPatternsOfOceanTides.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify regional and temporal variations in tidal water levels and their implications for coastlines and navigation, distinguishing tidal cycles from persistent ocean currents.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jağalaudağy tolysu-qaitudy oryn men uaqyt boiynşa salystyr.

#### Özender men su jinalu alaptary

Skills: 2

[index.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/riversAndDrainageBasins/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Flowing water links sources, tributaries and outlets into networks, while topography governs the surface catchment of a river. Describing different types of water bodies as objects belongs to Geographic Objects.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Būlaqtar men özender qalai su ağyny jelısın qūraitynyn bıl.

##### Jer bederı arqyly su jinalu alabyn belgıleu

[delineateADrainageBasinFromTerrain.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/riversAndDrainageBasins/delineateADrainageBasinFromTerrain.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infer the land area contributing runoff to an outlet using divides and slopes rather than administrative borders.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Özennıñ belgılı bır nüktesıne suy ağatyn jer aumağyn anyqta.

##### Özen jüiesınıñ negızgı bölıkterın anyqtau

[identifyTheMainPartsOfARiverNetwork.ts](../../../content/geography/data/skills/waterSystems/riversAndDrainageBasins/identifyTheMainPartsOfARiverNetwork.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish source, tributary, confluence, channel, and mouth by their roles in connected flow.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Özen bastauy, salalary, qosylystary, arnasy men sağasyn tany.
